class.name: CheckBox
class.brief_description: A button that represents a binary choice.
class.description: [CheckBox] allows the user to choose one of only two possible options. It's similar to [CheckButton] in functionality, but it has a different appearance. To follow established UX patterns, it's recommended to use [CheckBox] when toggling it has [b]no[/b] immediate effect on something. For example, it could be used when toggling it will only do something once a confirmation button is pressed. See also [BaseButton] which contains common properties and methods associated with this node. When [member BaseButton.button_group] specifies a [ButtonGroup], [CheckBox] changes its appearance to that of a radio button and uses the various [code]radio_*[/code] theme properties.

The style box of the check when the [CheckBox] is checked. If one of the check style boxes isn't a [StyleBoxEmpty], the check is drawn with them instead of the icons, and changes between the states with the style transitions. It then has the largest minimum size of these style boxes in every state, and a [StyleBoxEmpty] draws nothing. [theme_item checkbox_checked_color] and [theme_item checkbox_unchecked_color] don't tint them, set the colors in the style boxes instead.
The style box of the check when the [CheckBox] is checked and disabled, see [theme_item checked]. If it's a [StyleBoxEmpty], [theme_item checked] is used instead.
